The host half registers `GET /api/"},{"id":"p9s3","text":"token-stats` and `POST /api/token-stats/rescan` through `connection.fetch`, behind the Web UI's Host"},{"id":"p9s4","text":"/Origin and browser-session checks; the client half registers a "Settings → Stats" section and fetch"},{"id":"p9s5","text":"es the API.
- **Dynamic-plugin form** (for maintainers/iteration): `host.js` and `client.js` are pas"},{"id":"p9s6","text":"ted into `cordis_define` for in-session deployment without restarting the profile."},{"id":"p10s1","text":"Data flow:"},{"id":"p11s1","text":"1. Host subscribes to `session/event` / `session/created` and also performs an initial backfill over"},{"id":"p11s2","text":" historical session logs.
2. It folds `assistant/message.usage`, `request/header` model attribution,"},{"id":"p11s3","text":" and `turn/start`/`turn/end` durations into in-memory aggregates.
3. Aggregates are periodically flu"},{"id":"p11s4","text":"shed to the host JSON storage unit `token_stats` (normally `<DSH_HOME>/storages/token_stats.json`); "},{"id":"p11s5","text":"on restart the snapshot is loaded first, then only new events are incrementally folded. Older Harnes"},{"id":"p11s6","text":"s versions expose `sessionPersistence.readFrom` for suffix reads; versions without it use `sessionQu"},{"id":"p11s7","text":"ery.readSession` to read the full log while still folding only new events.
4. The client polls `GET "},{"id":"p11s8","text":"/api/token-stats` (2s while scanning, 30s after ready) and renders the dashboard."},{"id":"p12s1","text":"An explicit rescan rebuilds from the current logs and replaces all aggregates only after every read "},{"id":"p12s2","text":"succeeds. Repeated or simultaneous rescans do not accumulate history again. Live events received dur"},{"id":"p12s3","text":"ing replay are merged in sequence order. Normal restarts retain statistics for deleted sessions; an "},{"id":"p12s4","text":"explicit rescan removes that history when the logs are gone.
